name: Pocket ID
short_desc: Passkey-only OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider.
author: Pocket ID
description: Lightweight OpenID Connect Certified™ identity provider that signs users in with passkeys. Single container with SQLite; no passwords and no extra database.

form_fields.label: Application URL
form_fields.hint: Public HTTPS URL of this instance (must match the Traefik domain). Passkeys require HTTPS except on exact localhost. Do not change after the first admin passkey is registered.

form_fields.label: Encryption Key
form_fields.hint: Auto-generated key for token signing material. Keep it with your backups; changing it makes existing data unreadable.

form_fields.label: Trust Proxy
form_fields.hint: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from Traefik. Leave on when the app is exposed.
